resources.string: The city closest to 5 PM, with live digital and analogue clocks.
A little reminder that it is almost five somewhere. Add the widget to your home screen; tap its clock to open the full app.
Leave blank to open these settings instead. Settings apply to all widgets.
Enter an http:// or https:// URL with a valid hostname.
Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, then 5PM Clock.
No browser is available to open the clock.
The clocks tick locally without a background JavaScript process. City changes use precise alarms while the phone is active. Updates can be deferred while asleep and are recalculated after delivery.
